title: Sequential Multimodal Evidence Optimization for Product Media Ranking in E-Commerce
abstract: arXiv:2608.15662v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On modern e-commerce stores, customers consume ordered slates of heterogeneous product media, such as images, videos, and 3D renders, before making purchase decisions. Existing media-ranking systems often optimize myopic engagement proxies such as clicks or dwell time, even though product media assets are cooperative informational components of the same item that together help customers find the information they need through sequential interaction. We present Sequential Multimodal Evidence Optimization (SMEO), a two-stage utility-guided framework for customer-oriented media sequencing. SMEO first learns a trajectory utility model from consumed media prefixes to estimate how ordered evidence helps customers reach a purchase decision, while mitigating position-bias and variable-depth imbalance in logged data. translated_title: 电子商务中产品媒体排序的序列多模态证据优化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15662v1 公告类型：新 摘要：在现代电子商务商店中，顾客在做出购买决定之前，会消费有序的异构产品媒体列表，如图像、视频和3D渲染。现有的媒体排序系统通常优化短视的参与度代理指标，如点击率或停留时间，尽管产品媒体资产是同一商品的合作性信息组件，它们共同通过顺序交互帮助顾客找到所需信息。我们提出了序列多模态证据优化（SMEO），一个两阶段、以效用为导向的框架，用于面向客户的媒体排序。SMEO首先从消费的媒体前缀中学习一个轨迹效用模型，以估计有序证据如何帮助顾客达成购买决策，同时减轻记录数据中的位置偏差和可变深度不平衡。鉴于客户注意力是有限资源，它随后训练一个带有生存加权奖励的自回归排序策略。
tldr: SMEO提出了一种两阶段框架，通过轨迹效用建模和生存加权奖励的自回归排序策略，优化产品媒体顺序以促进购买决策，同时应对位置偏差和注意力限制。
en_tdlr: SMEO proposes a two-stage framework that optimizes product media sequencing via trajectory utility modeling and survival-weighted autoregressive ranking, addressing position bias and limited attention to enhance purchase decisions.
